messages:
devon: quick experiment idea — add an opt-in request header that carries a compact "shape-hint" for embeddings so the router can pick a compatible route for mixed-dim batches. anyone object?

 taylor: can you sketch the header? curious if this is just dims or full shape metadata.

 devon: minimal to start — dims + count. example:

 ```
 X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536; items=8
 ```

 devon: router would prefer routes that match dims exactly, otherwise fall back to dim-agnostic shard (slower). header stays optional.

 maya: major question — how does this affect quota/console? metrics need to show when we route by shape vs fallback. ops will scream if costs jump.

 samir: runtime concerns: matching dims helps batching and kernel selection, but we must avoid head-of-line blocking if one request waits for same-dim mates. propose a 50ms coalesce window + max-batch to reduce starvation.

 taylor: 50ms ok but can we expose a flag to turn off shape-routing per-tenant? some customers want deterministic cost not routing variance.

 devon: yeah per-tenant toggle makes sense. default off for existing tenants, opt-in via account config. rollout via feature-flag.

 maya: for console UX: add a small widget to model route analytics showing "shape routed %", avg latency by route, and estimated token-unit delta. simple sparkline + breakdown.

 samir: telemetry proposal: emit an event `shape_route_decision` with fields: route, dims (if present), batch_size, fallback_reason (if any). that will power the console card + alerts.

 devon: example preflight + cost estimate endpoint we could return for clients that want to preview routing:

 ```bash
 curl -H 'X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536;items=8' -d '{"input_count":8}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/preflight

 # returns
 {"route":"gpu-pool-1536","est_cost":0.0042,"will_batch":true}
 ```

 taylor: nice. console can call preflight in the debug panel to show why a request chose a route.

 maya: also add a telemetry tag when preflight used, so we can audit any divergence between preflight and actual.

 samir: edge-case: mixed batches where some vectors lack dims header. router should allow partial-match: try exact-dim route if all have same dims header; else fallback. do NOT attempt to autosplit mixed dims in router — too many permutations.

 devon: agreed. we should keep client-side splitter as authoritative for mixed dims. we can document best practices: include shape-hint or pre-split before sending.

 taylor: client SDKs can add automatic header when user sends homogenous array. add note in changelog.

 infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout plan created: feature-flag `shape_routing_v1`, staged to 10% accounts on Monday, health checks + metric dashboards attached.

 devon: action items: dev (samir) - implement router check + 50ms coalesce; api (taylor) - preflight endpoint + client SDK hook; ux (maya) - console card mock; infra - add telemetry event schema.

 maya: +1, will mock in Figma and share by EOD Thursday.

 samir: I'll spike the router patch and push a draft PR today.

 taylor: once PR lands, QA please run mixed-dim stress with large payloads — we want to ensure we don't increase 413/fastfail rate.

 devon: noted. also consider a conservative telemetry alert: if fallback route percent > 20% in first 24h, rollback flag.

 deploy-bot: NOTE: canary deploy scheduled Thu 18:00 UTC if all tests pass. :rocket:
